messages:
kai: Heads up — ran quant8x4 smoke against the new model + our updated golden. Seeing ~0.7% quality drop on the 'synth-edgecases' family of promptsets. Suspect duplicate synthetic seeds leaking into holdouts. Quick triage?
sanjay: On it. which promptset exactly? can you share sample ids or fingerprints?
kai: @sanjay it's the synth-edgecases bank we merged yesterday (v3). I ran a quick fingerprint scan and found overlaps with the holdout slice. Harvest job finished at 10:23.
harvest-bot: harvest-bot: sampling job completed: synth-edgecases v3 merged -> 2431 new items. job_id: hj-2218
mina: @kai can you paste the dedupe query you ran? i'll kick off a fingerprint diff and cross-check golden vs holdout.
kai: here's the quick query I used:
```
SELECT sample_id, fingerprint FROM samples WHERE bank='synth-edgecases' AND created_at >= '2026-03-18';
```
Found ~112 fingerprints that also appear in holdout indexes.
labeling-ops: If there are true duplicates we should remove them from the holdout not the golden. Golden is our QA anchor and should stay stable. Also we'll need to reassign labeler batches if we alter holdout.
sanjay: Agree. proposed plan: 1) identify exact duplicates and mark holdout rows as `leak:duplicate` 2) refresh holdout with reservoir samples to preserve size 3) re-run quant smoke. anyone object?
mina: :thumbsup: fine. i'll run the fingerprint diff and push flags. ETA ~30m.
kai: note some are near-duplicates / paraphrases. we should run a fuzzy dedupe (minhash) and only flag pairs above 0.92 sim. i'll share the script.
kai: ```
python scripts/fuzzy_dedupe.py --src synth-edgecases --target holdouts --threshold 0.92 --out flagged.csv
```
harvest-bot: harvest-bot: job queued: fuzzy-dedupe hj-2218-fz; estimated 12m
labeling-ops: when flagged.csv is ready i'll take ownership of holdout flagging and open a change ticket (SRE + data infra). also please pause any golden refresh jobs until we confirm.
sanjay: one more: capture which labeler `batch_id` touched those samples so we can avoid relabel churn and trace back QA flips. add `batch_id` to the report.
mina: good call. will add `batch_id` and push a csv with cols: sample_id,fingerprint,batch_id,sim_score,flag_reason. will post here when done.
kai: if the smoke re-run still shows regression after dedupe, we should check quant kernel differences (kernel selection and kv cache behavior). but start with dedupe. thanks :rocket:
